why: Today's lead tooling adds three closed host fault cases, exact matcher/frame checks, and trusted reporter case binding. Safe unit laws pass 17, phase machine 1, workflow policy 1. Six deliberate tooling faults failed and restored identical bytes. An initial raw-stack fault stayed green because the privacy check omitted JSON-escaped text; that check was corrected and the fault then failed. Protected reporter fixture and actual host fault triplets were not run. Compiler, full lint, API checks, source recheck, publication and CI remain lead-owned.
